review.tagline: Turns a topic into a short video with script, footage, voiceover and subtitles
review.summary: MoneyPrinterTurbo takes a topic or keywords and produces a finished short video. An LLM writes the script, footage comes from Pexels, Pixabay, Coverr, local files or text-to-video APIs, and TTS, subtitles and background music are added before the final render. It offers a WebUI, HTTP API, CLI and an agent skill, and outputs 9:16, 16:9 or 1:1.
review.audience: Creators and developers automating short-form video production
strengths: Covers the whole pipeline: script, footage, voiceover, subtitles, music and render
Many LLM providers, including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and Ollama for local models
Edge TTS needs no API key; Pexels and Pixabay stock footage are free
WebUI, API, CLI and batch generation; Docker and compose files included
weaknesses: Most LLMs and stock sources need API keys; AI video generation uses paid services
Footage relevance depends on keyword matching against stock libraries
README is dominated by sponsor and promotional sections
Web port and Docker setup details are not visible in the provided README
needs: Needs Python 3.11+, LLM API key or Ollama, Pexels/Pixabay/Coverr API keys, Edge TTS or other TTS service
Models: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen
